decisions.reason: Turnaround management builds directly on the firm's docking and gate knowledge, so it can interpret field results and keep refining the product, and its dedicated web page shows continued strategic weight.
Apron connectivity is an enabling layer for the integrated data platform, and in-house R&D lets the firm learn from deployments, though as a mere module it could be folded into broader offerings.
Billing is furthest from the firm's engineering knowledge base, which limits learning, but it rounds out the integrated suite and costs little to keep while the software business expands.
Equipment monitoring uses the firm's installed-base and maintenance expertise, feeding its service growth and giving it field data to learn from.
Apron resource management is close to the established offer and fits the move toward automated operations, so the firm can absorb customer feedback well.
The controller safety alert service extends the firm's tower and surveillance know-how, which its R&D can use to improve the service and support it over the long term.
